```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(DHARMa)
library(performance)
library(glmmLasso)
library(lme4)
library(sjPlot)
library(car)
library(glmmTMB)
library(caret)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}
df_la <- read.csv("2026_insecticideanalyses_upload_csv.csv")%>% 
  dplyr::select(-Area2025cia, -sum_ITN) %>% 
  rename(Malaria = Malaria_rate, Dengue = Dengue_rate) %>% 
  filter(mean_temp > -200)  %>% #Removing island countries ERA5 doesn't have data for
  mutate(Pop = as.numeric(Pop)) %>% 
  dplyr::select(Country, newITN, sum_RS, sum_SS, sum_LA, Dengue, Malaria, mean_temp, mean_precip, hdi, Pop, TotalPop) %>% 
  drop_na()

df_la$sum_2 <- df_la$sum_LA 

df_la$Y = log(df_la$sum_2 + 0.001)

df_la$Y2 = log((df_la$sum_2+0.001)/df_la$TotalPop)

df_la$Country = as.factor(df_la$Country)

df_la$Malaria <- log1p(df_la$Malaria)
df_la$Dengue <- log1p(df_la$Dengue)
df_la$Pop <- log1p(df_la$Pop)
df_la$mean_precip <- log1p(df_la$mean_precip)
df_la$sum_SS <- log1p(df_la$sum_SS/df_la$TotalPop)
df_la$newITN <- log1p(df_la$newITN/df_la$TotalPop)
df_la$sum_RS <- log1p(df_la$sum_RS/df_la$TotalPop)

df_la[,c(2:4, 6:11)] <- scale(df_la[,c(2:4, 6:11)])
df_la <- data.frame(df_la)
```

1) The binomial model
Defining the binomial response
```{r}
df_la$LA <- as.integer(df_la$sum_2 > 0)
family = binomial(link = "logit")
```


Testing polynomial
```{r}
m <- glmmTMB(LA ~ (Malaria + Dengue + mean_temp + mean_precip + hdi + Pop + sum_SS + sum_RS + newITN)^2 + (1|Country),  
                            family = family, data = df_la)

m2 <- glmmTMB(LA ~ (Malaria + Dengue + poly(mean_temp, 2) + mean_precip + hdi + Pop + sum_SS + sum_RS + newITN)^2 + (1|Country),  
                            family = family, data = df_la)

m3 <- glmmTMB(LA ~ (Malaria + Dengue + mean_temp + poly(mean_precip, 2) + hdi + Pop + sum_SS + sum_RS + newITN)^2 + (1|Country),  
                            family = family, data = df_la)

BIC(m, m2, m3)
```


Checking on maximum lambda
```{r}
m <- glmmLasso(LA ~ (Malaria + Dengue + mean_temp + mean_precip + hdi + Pop + sum_RS + sum_SS + newITN)^2, rnd = list(Country=~1),  
                            family = family, data = df_la, lambda=325, switch.NR = TRUE, final.re = TRUE) 

summary(m)
```
Max lambda is 325

```{r}
set.seed(2)
N<-dim(df_la)[1]
ind<-sample(N,N)
lambda <- exp(seq(log(325), log(325 * .0001), length.out = 200))

kk<-5
nk <- floor(N/kk)

Devianz_ma<-matrix(Inf,ncol=kk,nrow=length(lambda))

library(MASS);library(nlme)
PQL <- glmmPQL(LA~ 1,random = ~1|Country,family=family,data=df_la)

Delta.start <- as.matrix(t(c(as.numeric(PQL$coef$fixed),rep(0,45),as.numeric(t(PQL$coef$random$Country)))))
Q.start <- as.numeric(VarCorr(PQL)[1,1])

for (i in 1:kk)
{
  print(paste("CV Loop ", i,sep=""))
  
    if (i < kk)
    {
      indi <- ind[(i-1)*nk+(1:nk)]
    }else{
      indi <- ind[((i-1)*nk+1):N]
    }
    
    df2.train<-df_la[-indi,]
    df2.test<-df_la[indi,]
    
    Delta.start.loop <- Delta.start
    Q.start.loop <- Q.start
    
    for(j in 1:length(lambda))
    {
      glm4 <- try(glmmLasso(LA~(Malaria + Dengue + mean_temp + mean_precip + hdi + Pop + sum_RS + sum_SS + newITN)^2, rnd = list(Country=~1),  
                            family = family, data = df2.train, lambda=lambda[j], switch.NR=TRUE, final.re=TRUE,
                            control=list(start=Delta.start.loop, q_start=Q.start.loop)),
                  silent=TRUE) 
      
      if(!inherits(glm4, "try-error"))
      {  
        y.hat <- predict(glm4, df2.test)

        Delta.start.loop <- glm4$Deltamatrix[glm4$conv.step,]
        Q.start.loop <- glm4$Q_long[[glm4$conv.step+1]]
        
        Devianz_ma[j,i] <- sum(family$dev.resids(df2.test$LA, y.hat, wt=rep(1, length(y.hat)))) 
      }
    }
}

Devianz_vec<-apply(Devianz_ma,1,sum)
opt4<-which.min(Devianz_vec)

## now fit full model until optimal lambda
for(j in 1:opt4)
{  
glm4.big <- glmmLasso(LA~(Malaria + Dengue + mean_temp + mean_precip + hdi + Pop + sum_RS + sum_SS + newITN)^2, rnd = list(Country=~1),  
                        family = family, data = df_la, lambda=lambda[j],switch.NR=TRUE,final.re=TRUE,
                        control=list(start=Delta.start[j,],q_start=Q.start[j]))
Delta.start<-rbind(Delta.start,glm4.big$Deltamatrix[glm4.big$conv.step,])
Q.start<-c(Q.start,glm4.big$Q_long[[glm4.big$conv.step+1]])
}

glm4_final <- glm4.big
```



```{r}
plot(lambda, Devianz_vec,
     type = "b", 
     xlab = "Lambda",
     ylab = "Cross-Validated Deviance",
     main = "Cross-Validation Deviance vs. Lambda",
     log = "x"
)

opt4_lambda <- lambda[opt4]
points(opt4_lambda, Devianz_vec[opt4], col = "red", pch = 19, cex = 1.5)
abline(v = opt4_lambda, col = "red", lty = 2)
text(opt4_lambda, min(Devianz_vec), paste("Optimal Lambda:", round(opt4_lambda, 3)),
     pos = 4, col = "red")

```
10.579

Plot this model
```{r}
selected_fixed_effects <- names(glm4_final$coefficients[glm4_final$coefficients != 0])
selected_fixed_effects <- selected_fixed_effects[-1]
fixed_formula_selected <- as.formula(paste("LA ~", paste(selected_fixed_effects, collapse = " + "), "+ (1|Country)"))

model_refit <- glmmTMB(LA ~ Malaria + Dengue + mean_temp + hdi + sum_RS + Malaria*hdi + 
    Dengue*hdi + Dengue*newITN + mean_temp*sum_SS + hdi*sum_RS + 
    hdi*newITN + (1 | Country), data = df_la, family = family)
summary(model_refit)
car::Anova(model_refit, type = "III")

res <- simulateResiduals(model_refit)
plot(res)
```

Repeated k-folds CV:
```{r}
library(rsample)
library(glmmTMB)
library(performance)
library(caret)

k <- 5
n_repeats <- 50
all_repeats_results <- list()

for (r in 1:n_repeats) {
  set.seed(189943 + r)
  folds <- createFolds(df_la$Country, k = k)
  cv_results <- list()
  for (i in 1:k) {
    indi <- folds[[i]]
    test_data <- df_la[-indi,]
    train_data <- df_la[indi,]
    
    test_obs <- test_data$LA
  train_obs <- train_data$LA
    
    model_cv <- glmmTMB(
      LA ~ Malaria + Dengue + mean_temp + hdi + sum_RS + Malaria*hdi + 
    Dengue*hdi + Dengue*newITN + mean_temp*sum_SS + hdi*sum_RS + 
    hdi*newITN  + (1 | Country),
      family = family,
      data = train_data)
    
    test_pred <- predict(model_cv, newdata = test_data, type = "response", allow.new.levels = TRUE)
    train_pred <- predict(model_cv, newdata = train_data, type = "response")
    
    test_r2 <- cor(test_pred, test_obs, use = "complete.obs")^2
    train_r2 <- cor(train_pred, train_obs, use = "complete.obs")^2
    
    test_auc <- as.numeric(pROC::roc(test_obs, test_pred, quiet = TRUE)$auc)
  train_auc <- as.numeric(pROC::roc(train_obs, train_pred, quiet = TRUE)$auc)
    
    cv_results[[i]] <- data.frame(
      Repeat = r,
      Fold = i,
      Test_R2 = as.numeric(test_r2),
      Train_R2 = as.numeric(train_r2),
      Test_AUC = test_auc,
      Train_AUC = train_auc
    )
  }
  
  all_repeats_results[[r]] <- do.call(rbind, cv_results)
}

final_summary <- do.call(rbind, all_repeats_results)

grand_summary <- final_summary %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_Test_R2 = mean(Test_R2, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD_Test_R2 = sd(Test_R2, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_Train_R2 = mean(Train_R2, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_Test_AUC = mean(Test_AUC, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_Train_AUC = mean(Train_AUC, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

print(grand_summary)
```

```{r}
df_la <- df_la %>%
```

Testing polynomial
```{r}
m <- glmmTMB(log(sum_2 + 0.001) ~ (Malaria + Dengue + mean_temp + mean_precip + hdi + Pop + sum_SS + sum_RS + newITN)^2 + (1|Country) + offset(log(TotalPop)),  
                            family = family, data = df_la)

m2 <- glmmTMB(log(sum_2 + 0.001) ~ (Malaria + Dengue + poly(mean_temp, 2) + mean_precip + hdi + Pop + sum_SS + sum_RS + newITN)^2 + (1|Country)+ offset(log(TotalPop)),  
                            family = family, data = df_la)

m3 <- glmmTMB(log(sum_2 + 0.001) ~ (Malaria + Dengue + mean_temp + poly(mean_precip, 2) + hdi + Pop + sum_SS + sum_RS + newITN)^2 + (1|Country)+ offset(log(TotalPop)),  
                            family = family, data = df_la)

BIC(m, m2, m3)
```

```{r}
set.seed(12834)
N<-dim(df_la)[1]
ind<-sample(N,N)
lambda <- exp(seq(log(810), log(810 * .0001), length.out = 200))

kk<-5
nk <- floor(N/kk)

Devianz_ma<-matrix(Inf,ncol=kk,nrow=length(lambda))

library(MASS);library(nlme)
PQL <- glmmPQL(Y2~ 1,random = ~1|Country,family=family,data=df_la)

Delta.start <- as.matrix(t(c(as.numeric(PQL$coef$fixed),rep(0,45),as.numeric(t(PQL$coef$random$Country)))))
Q.start <- as.numeric(VarCorr(PQL)[1,1])

for (i in 1:kk)
{
  print(paste("CV Loop ", i,sep=""))
  
    if (i < kk)
    {
      indi <- ind[(i-1)*nk+(1:nk)]
    }else{
      indi <- ind[((i-1)*nk+1):N]
    }
    
    df2.train<-df_la[-indi,]
    df2.test<-df_la[indi,]
    
    Delta.start.loop <- Delta.start
    Q.start.loop <- Q.start
    
    for(j in 1:length(lambda))
    {
      glm4 <- try(glmmLasso(Y2~(Malaria + Dengue + mean_temp + mean_precip + hdi + Pop + sum_RS + sum_SS + newITN)^2, rnd = list(Country=~1),  
                            family = family, data = df2.train, lambda=lambda[j], switch.NR=TRUE, final.re=TRUE,
                            control=list(start=Delta.start.loop, q_start=Q.start.loop)),
                  silent=TRUE) 
      
      if(!inherits(glm4, "try-error"))
      {  
        y.hat <- predict(glm4, df2.test)
        
        
        Delta.start.loop <- glm4$Deltamatrix[glm4$conv.step,]
        Q.start.loop <- glm4$Q_long[[glm4$conv.step+1]]
        
        Devianz_ma[j,i] <- sum(family$dev.resids(df2.test$Y2, y.hat, wt=rep(1, length(y.hat)))) 
      }
    }
}

Delta.start<-rbind(Delta.start,glm4.big$Deltamatrix[glm4.big$conv.step,])
Q.start<-c(Q.start,glm4.big$Q_long[[glm4.big$conv.step+1]])
}
```

Repeated k-folds CV:
```{r}
library(rsample)
library(glmmTMB)
library(performance)
library(caret)

k <- 5
n_repeats <- 50
all_repeats_results <- list()

for (r in 1:n_repeats) {
  set.seed(1872333 + r)
  folds <- createFolds(df_la$Country, k = k)
  cv_results <- list()
  
  for (i in 1:k) {
    indi <- folds[[i]]
    test_data <- df_la[-indi,]
    train_data <- df_la[indi,]
    
    model_cv <- glmmTMB(
      log(sum_2 + 0.001) ~ Dengue + Malaria*sum_SS + hdi*sum_RS + 
    (1 | Country) + offset(log(TotalPop)),
      family = family,
      data = train_data)
    
    test_pred <- predict(model_cv, newdata = test_data, type = "response", allow.new.levels = TRUE)
    train_pred <- predict(model_cv, newdata = train_data, type = "response")
    
    test_r2 <- cor(test_pred, log(test_data$sum_2 + 0.001), use = "complete.obs")^2
    train_r2 <- cor(train_pred, log(train_data$sum_2 + 0.001), use = "complete.obs")^2
    
    cv_results[[i]] <- data.frame(
      Repeat = r,
      Fold = i,
      Test_R2 = as.numeric(test_r2),
      Train_R2 = as.numeric(train_r2)
    )
  }
  all_repeats_results[[r]] <- do.call(rbind, cv_results)
}

final_summary <- do.call(rbind, all_repeats_results)

grand_summary <- final_summary %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_Test_R2 = mean(Test_R2, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD_Test_R2 = sd(Test_R2, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_Train_R2 = mean(Train_R2, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

print(grand_summary)
```
